subject: biology

hotspots.label: Gut microbiome
hotspots.description: The largest community of the microbiome, living along the intestines.
hotspots.positionHint: The dense band of microbe dots along the intestinal tract.
hotspots.function: The biggest colony, mostly helping with digestion.

hotspots.label: Skin microbiome
hotspots.description: The microbes living on the surface of your skin.
hotspots.positionHint: A sparse band of dots over the arm or torso outline.
hotspots.function: Colony of microbes living on the skin.

hotspots.label: Mostly bacteria
hotspots.description: Most members of the microbiome are bacteria, with a few fungi like yeast.
hotspots.positionHint: A magnified inset showing the dot shapes are mostly bacteria-like.
hotspots.function: Shows most members are tiny bacteria.

hotspots.label: Helpful jobs
hotspots.description: The helpful jobs the microbiome does: digestion, vitamins, immune training.
hotspots.positionHint: Small label pins over the gut in the jobs layer.
hotspots.function: Digests food, makes vitamins, trains the immune system.

hotspots.label: Balanced community
hotspots.description: The state where the mix of microbes stays balanced and healthy.
hotspots.positionHint: The even, mixed distribution of colored dots in the balance view.
hotspots.function: Represents a healthy balanced mix of microbes.

visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier bar throughout: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with a soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A calm stylized silhouette of a human body with soft skin tone and a highlighted gut, overlaid with small clean microbe dots. Restrained warm palette, not gamey, not cluttered, no glow. Strong saturated color reserved for the small hotspot dots and the microbe dots.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0, matte roughness ~0.5-0.65. Microbe dots are simple small spheres; no emissive.
assetBrief: SUBJECT: a soft neutral silhouette of a human body with the digestive tract highlighted, and a dense, gentle field of tiny dots representing the microbiome along the gut and more sparsely on the skin. A magnified inset shows the dots are mostly bacteria shapes, with some yeast. Layers animate helpful-job labels and a balanced mixed view. Named nodes: BodySilhouette, GutTract, SkinSurface, MicrobeDots, JobLabels, BalanceView. Budget 14-18k.
